flowRoot.flowPara: • The dark red spaces on the map grid is the preferred start space for Golgothon. If those spaces are blocked by walls or pillars, he can be shifted into an open area within the lighter red squares.

• Golgothon is a huge creature made largely of earth and stone. If players wonder why he can push them around when he moves and why their debuffs and forced movement effects aren't as effective, that's why!
• Keep in mind that forced movements always force a unit at least 1 square, even if that unit has Sturdy.
• Shuffle 25 map tiles and lay them out in 5 rows of 5 tiles each, forming a 5x5 tile battlefield (10x10 total squares).
• Determine which side of the battlefield is north.
• The starting locations for Golgothon and the player units are marked on the grid to the right:
(This value is tuned for a 4-player group. For information on scaling the encounter for more or less players, see p.8)
• Resolve 2 (Debuffs do not apply to this unit until it has 2 debuffs of the same type. It clears 2 debuffs at a time.)
• Large (This unit takes up a 2x2 space on the map.)
• Trample (This unit can enter squares occupied by other units. If it does, those units are forced into the nearest open square.)
• Sturdy 1 (Any forced movement against this unit is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1.)
